messages:
nina: FYI onboarding demo showed bad rerank after we flipped to the new embeddings model. numbers look off and there are duplicates in results. error from app: `Dim mismatch: 1536 != 1024`

omar: which SDKs are in the demo?

nina: Node sampleapp + internal Go retriever. API returned 1536-dim embedding (model drift). Node parsed `data[0].embedding` fine (1536). Go retriever's batcher normalized to 1024 during batch-merge which truncated vectors. Meanwhile retry logic in Node produced a second successful call so we had duplicate candidates.

leah: any auth logs? retries often come from token refresh.

ci-bot: [1742509991] 401 Unauthorized for POST /v1/embeddings req=rmq-77
ci-bot: [1742509992] token refresh succeeded
ci-bot: [1742509993] retry request req=rmq-77 status=200

sam: sounds like three issues colliding: 1) response field-name variants (`embedding` vs `vectors`), 2) dim change (1024 -> 1536) and 3) inconsistent retry/merge semantics across SDKs. Go merges retried requests into in-flight batches and applies truncate/pad behavior; Node retries as separate call which causes duplicates.

omar: quick mitigation ideas?

nina: propose: a) batcher should preserve raw vectors until validation step (no silent truncation), b) add opt-in strict mode that fails fast on dim mismatch, c) require Idempotency-Key for retries so retried requests are deduped, d) canonicalize SDK response shape to always use `embedding` for single and `embeddings` for batch.

sam: agreed. I'll open a small Go PR to stop truncation on merge and to add an env flag `STRICT_EMBED_DIM=true` that errors when dims differ. Also map `vectors` -> `embedding` when parsing.

leah: I'll patch the sampleapp (Node) to set Idempotency-Key on retry and to validate dims before inserting candidates. Workaround snippet for teams:
```js
const v = resp?.data?.[0]?.embedding || resp?.data?.[0]?.vectors;
if (!v || v.length !== EXPECTED_DIM) throw new Error(`bad dim ${v?.length}`);
client.defaults.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = requestId;
```

omar: nice. I'll add a short note in onboarding saying "verify EXPECTED_DIM after model upgrades" and include the snippet. Also add automated test that simulates 401->refresh->retry and asserts no duplicates and no silent truncation.

ci-bot: [1742510038] PRs: sample-apps#213 (node: idempotency + dim check), retriever-go#57 (defer-validate-preserve-raw). CI: 6/6 for both.

sam: filing follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4350 label=devex/embeddings. We should add SDK parity tests (python/node/go/rust) to catch this early.

nina: thanks all. shipping mitigation to onboarding and sampleapp today. will follow up with unit tests for the batcher retry flow. :rocket:
